# FG-DB-0002

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`db-unavailable`](../../ops/runbooks/db-unavailable.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_slow_statement_is_db_query_failed_with_sqlstate_57014` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: データベースの処理に失敗しました。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: A database operation failed. Contact the administrator.
- id: Operasi basis data gagal. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

A statement failed on an open connection: it exceeded database.statement_timeout_ms (SQLSTATE 57014) or database.lock_timeout_ms (55P03), the connection was lost, or the server reported another error.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `query` (a static name of the statement — never its SQL text or parameters), `sqlstate` and `reason` (statement_timeout, lock_timeout, connection_lost, server_error, client_error — e.g. a decode error). For timeouts, look for long-running or blocking sessions in pg_stat_activity and pg_locks at that time; look up other SQLSTATEs in the PostgreSQL documentation.

## 対処 (fix)

For timeouts remove the blocking session or fix the slow plan (EXPLAIN); for connection loss check the server log (restart, network); for other states fix the caller named by `query`.
